column3: Settings search filters the nav through a per-page terms list of section and row labels, and the open page's rows by label and helper text
column4: Pages mount their ops on open, so rendering every page to search it would send every page's reads; a static list costs nothing, and an e2e test that searches every rendered label keeps it from drifting
column5: e2e: every section and row label on every page finds that page from the search
